decision_question: Is the supplied input sufficient to register bench BENCH-SZ-01 and open its round plan?
hypothesis: BENCH-SZ-01 records its availability windows, cycle time and per-run cost sufficient for later slot planning, and CMP-001 records its rounds, their stop states and its paired design, so the inner loop can run up to 6 bench rounds.
uncertainty: Supplied availability, cycle time and cost are not independently verified; recorded ASSUMED evidence remains assumed and this record does not reserve capacity, book a run, or establish a capability conclusion. The plan's rounds are recorded as they happened, and a later round's outcome is not known before it runs.
decision_rule: Register the bench and open its round plan only when availability windows, a positive cycle time, per-run cost with source, a recorded pairing design, and evidence without GAP are supplied; the cross-field ledger rules (current_iteration within max_iterations, only CONTINUE authorizes another round, exit-round-only model/next-batch references) are enforced by the validator.
result: BENCH-SZ-01 is sufficient to register a bench record; available_bench_slots=7; 1 round(s) recorded, standing at round 2 of 6 (max_iterations=6, supplied in the request).
next_action: Open bench round 2 of 6 with the pairing design recorded above.

evidence.statement: Synthetic bench registration recorded for schema validation only; not a booked or qualified capacity.
Synthetic round plan recorded for schema validation only; round 1 is a synthetic record and this is not product evidence.

pairing_design.description: Synthetic fixture: A/B pair runs in the same round and is swapped in the next round, so bench-to-bench drift cancels; at a fixed sigma, pairing buys more resolution than measuring sigma precisely.
